assets.prompt:
Use case: background-extraction.
Asset type: premium ecommerce product photography cutout for the existing Lauren alfajor website.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, an actual product presentation supplied by the owner. Edit this photo, do not invent a different product.
Primary request: remove the entire room/table/wall background to true transparent alpha. Improve exposure, white balance, local contrast and realistic detail moderately, like careful professional food-photo retouching. Keep the real pale shortbread biscuits and glossy caramel arequipe filling, the real packaging construction, arrangement, proportions and camera angle.
Composition: isolate the complete product group, recentered on a 1536x1024 landscape 3:2 transparent canvas. Fit its longest dimension to about 83 percent of the available frame while leaving clean margins on all sides. Never crop any part of the product. Product-only floating catalog cutout, no environment, no floor reflection, no vignette, no cast ground shadow, no pedestal added.
Lighting: soft warm-neutral studio lighting, appetizing pale cream biscuit color, rich caramel filling. Sharp but natural textures, no plastic-looking food or crunchy oversharpening.
Background: actual transparent alpha channel, not white or black and not a painted checkerboard. Edges precise without beige halos. Transparent packaging must remain transparent: the removed background must also disappear when seen through clear plastic.
Constraints: preserve the identity of each object in the source and the visible existing brand print. Never invent, replace, improve by rewriting, or add text, phone numbers, logos, labels, decorative graphics, garnishes or extra products. Do not add colored fillings or chocolate coatings.
Subject: the complete round four-biscuit-layer alfajor cake with THREE generous tiers of piped caramel dollops, powdered sugar on the top disk, THREE mini alfajores as its top decoration. Preserve all four disks and all three filling tiers. Retain its thin round white cake board because it is part of the presentation. Remove only the table and background.
